title: Unsplash Visuals
description: Preview-first Unsplash photo search with API-compliant hotlink previews, attribution and selected-use download tracking. The access key stays machine-local.

orientation.title: Orientation
orientation.description: Auto derives landscape, portrait or squarish from SceneIntent.

api_key_env.title: Access key environment variable
api_key_env.description: Name of the machine-local environment variable containing the Unsplash access key. The secret value is never stored in OmniCreator project data.
